observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the left margin and the locators «p. 191.» (L9) and «p. 192.» (L35) in the right margin.
body L13: the letter of the reference (b) is bold italic.
body L18, L20: «365ᵈ 5ʰ 55ᵐ 12ˢ» and «365ᵈ 5ʰ 46ᵐ 24ˢ» are written with small raised italic d, h, m and s (days, hours, minutes, seconds); the s of «12ˢ» is printed broken.
body L20: the long dash at the head of the line is the sign of the subtraction 365 1/4 less (3 2/5)/360; the fraction is set in two lines, with the small fraction 2/5 in its numerator.
body L9: specks stand over the e and the last m of «residuum» and under its second u, over the e of «directo» and over the u of «quod»; they are not accents.
body L10: the point after the 8 of «8. graduum» is printed small.
notes_left L4: the letter of «adn. a» is bold italic.
notes_left L6-L8: the Arabic words are «ونحوه» (L6, the reading of the codex), «او نحوه» (L7, Nallino's reading) and «نحوه» (L8, Plato's).
notes_left L8, L9: a speck stands under the m of «enim»; the quotation is set with « at the head of its second line.
notes_right L1: «365ᵈ 6ʰ 12ᵐ» is written with small raised italic d, h and m.
body L26: a speck stands over the u of «instrumenta»; it is not an accent.
body L36: a speck stands at the foot of the n of «in» before «100»; it is not a comma.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
